info.title: Ingleside at a glance
instructions: Break 1,000' · Pattern 800' · High key 3,000' · Low key 1,500'
Max 5 aircraft in the pattern, military or civil
info.source: Binder, p. 55; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 85.

info.title: Caution
instructions: The transitions conflict with multiple VFR routes and IFR approaches
Contact Approach as soon as possible for flight following
Be alert for IFR traffic at 1,600' MSL; remain below 3,000' unless in contact with Approach
info.source: Binder, p. 56; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 2, slide 86.
